policy: A quarantined provider stays registered, synced, mirrored, and audited; only its public site projection is withheld. Quarantine never deletes provider state or mirrored bytes. Lifting an entry requires resolving its recorded defect or redistribution restriction and republishing. An entry is justified by a defective public projection or documented redistribution restriction, not by incomplete acquisition, which is tracked in catalog/source-coverage instead.

quarantine.reason: The 12 hiring brochures have been retired from the current exam catalog into checksum-verified source revision recovery. The five genuine doctoral packages remain intact, but ROC 98 geophysics A explicitly says its fifth question's figure is copyrighted; its next page attributes the image to Genik (1993), AAPG Bulletin. CPC's reuse declaration does not resolve this specific third-party restriction. Resolve permission or a reviewed publication treatment before republishing the packages.
All 34 public records carry a synthetic 2026 event/year identity instead of the official 2022 level events, and three records point at wrong bytes after label collisions.

Both published non-basic bundles carry a synthetic ROC 115 identity forced by MATERIALS_YEAR onto undated material that is absent from the current exam scope, and 11 ZIPs are published as listening_audio because every ZIP suffix is treated as audio - including the five advanced writing-test ZIPs. The eight historical basic/elementary events are withheld with them: publishing that group would require a 30.02 GB archive of paired audio, and the Hakka Affairs Council's Open Government Data License expressly carves out audiovisual works, so redistribution is unresolved.
The adapter publishes 46 non-paper PDFs as questions while covering only 4 of 16 official families and omitting 34 paper-like PDFs.

The public ZIPs redistribute the 2012/2018 official practice workbooks, including all N1–N5 listening audio and N1/N2 passages covered by the official third-party reproduction restriction. The source inventory already records that redistribution is withheld; no permission covering this archive was established. Workbook edition years are also presented through the administered-exam year contract.
All 370 published records are Taipower new-hire papers whose URL and checksum sets exactly duplicate taipower_recruit; no MOEA-identified paper is actually published.
All 30 retained and published files are assigned to the wrong official category or event; embedded PDF headings contradict every adapter-derived event identity.

242 of 252 published records sit on the 47 PHIDs duplicated across 2025 and 2026, and only 6 of the 19 official category rows survive classification intact. Re-verified against the 2026-08-03 upstream refresh, which restored PHIDs 449 and 456 and so retired the stale-PHID finding of the 2026-08-01 capture.

All 35 retained records carry a synthetic 2026 event/year identity for undated source material. The A/B/C paper forms and their paired proficiency bands are now classified separately, but material nature, date evidence, and redistribution constraints remain unresolved.

The administered-paper adapter now separates dated events, sections, corrected answers and historical ZIP members, and retires the brochure from current papers. TII displays a copyright notice and no exam-PDF republication grant has been established; keep site bundles and public mirror backups withheld until the existing redistribution review is resolved.
92 of 95 published assets come from a rolling mock-test bank with no stable year, but are published under an unsupported synthetic 2026 process-year identity.
Nine public records point at the wrong bytes after five generic-label storage-key collisions overwrote distinct source PDFs.

The published bundle contains a byte-exact copy of the official ROC 107 ZIP whose PDF member is corrupt; outer-ZIP validation treats the nested official archive as an opaque payload and cannot detect it.
